Azaadi dimaag ke liye sabse achha tonic hai.
Khushi ek dhoop hai jo sone ke hazaron rangon se guzar sakti hai.
Aazadi asman se mila uphar nahi, hamari mehnat ka inaam hai.
Khushi santulan hai.
Khushi apni marzi se jeena hai.
Azadi sabse badi jeet hai.
Khushi achhai dekhna hai.
Anand anant sukh hai.
Ek mombatti se hazaron mombatti jal sakti hain, aur pehli mombatti ki roshni kam nahi hoti.
Azaadi sochne aur karne ka adhikar hai.
Khushi theek karne wali hai.
Khushi achhe se bitaye din ka inaam hai.
Happiness ek naye time zone mein uthna hai.
Khushi ek divya uphar hai.
Zindagi bhar ghulam rehne se behtar hai aazadi ke liye ladte hue marna.
Unke shukraguzar ho jo hamein khush rakhte hain; woh hamari rooh ko khilate hain.
Khushi hamare andar ki shuddh aag hai.
Khushi Bhagwan ki mahanta ki jhalak hai.
Khushi ishwar ki saans hai.
Khushi ghanti hai.
Khushi is baat ka sanket hai ki zindagi jawab de rahi hai.
Azadi jagah hai.
Wild raste sabse pure joy tak le jaate hain.
Khushi hone ki chamak hai.
Khushi aatma ki santushti hai.
Sabse badi aazadi alag tarah se sochne ka haq hai.
